# Fallout TV series: First official images from the upcoming Fallout Amazon Prime series

We already know that the new Fallout TV series will be available on Amazon Prime from April 12, 2024. Now there are the first official images of the series, which were shared by the @falloutonprime account on X (formerly Twitter).

See also: Fallout TV series starts on April 12, 2024 on Amazon Prime

## Fallout TV Series: Los Angeles / Vault 33

As we have already learned, the Fallout TV series is set in **Los Angeles** in **Vault 33**.

So far, **8 episodes** of the first season are planned, the first episode will be called "**The End**".
